dedupe_keys.name: mapa de riesgo inundacion fluvial economico t 100 anos

description: Mapa de riesgo inundación fluvial económico T=100 años is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.mapama.gob.es. Economic risk maps corresponding to an average or occasional flood probability scenario (100-year return period). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Risk Map Economic River Flood T=100 Years" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WMTS. The listing shows 2013-10-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
